system.requirement: Accuracy or Fighting 1 or higher, and Dexterity 1 or higher If you can see it, you can hit it. Hard.

degree0.desc: You can strike where it hurts the most. Once per round, you can add 1d6 to the damage of a successful attack if your Dexterity is greater than your target’s.

degree1.desc: Your instinct is as sharp as your eyes. When you take the Aim action, the attack bonus you gain is +2 instead of +1.

degree2.desc: You can perform the Called Shot action stunt for 3 SP instead of its normal cost. You can also use it with any weapon, not just firearms.
